unmeasured: Direct native-reference D2H/H2D roundtrip byte comparison

causal_scope.supported: One-image deduplicated visual execution differs from original two-image full batch in main and all3 DeepStack outputs while metadata/finite/storage checks pass.
causal_scope.hypothesis: Changing total patch/GEMM/merge batch shapes may change FP16 accumulation/algorithm choices; plausible from source, but no individual operator has been localized.
causal_scope.not_proved: The reference-vs-all-hit comparison reuses features already different from reference. It is not evidence that CPU transfer introduced the difference; direct copy-only equality has not been tested.

next_action: No further GPU or343 execution. Preserve v1 engineering failure and v2 numerical failure separately. Any new protocol must be separately authorized and preregistered.

proposals_only.name: Separate tolerance protocol with complete output and quality gates
proposals_only.design: First isolate copy-only byte equality from encoder shape changes. Pre-register feature tolerances separately from v2; do not relabel or pass v2. Cover every distinct miss count and duplicate/grid layout, then all343 same-weight exact token comparison and subset20 closed-loop quality. FP16 and AWQ use same cache rules and same frozen inputs; all online costs included.
proposals_only.limits: Tolerance thresholds require explicit prior choice; observed failure is not retrospective justification for relaxing the strict gate. No performance assumption.

proposals_only.name: Strict full-batch miss / all-hit-only cache
proposals_only.design: On any miss execute the untouched complete native visual batch, without dedup or smaller miss batch. Use full visual-batch identity plus all grids/order/dtype/source as the safest cache key; all-hit can skip whole visual execution, with copy-only byte gate. A finer image key would additionally require complete batch grid layout and original slot offsets and fresh byte validation.
proposals_only.limits: Preserves the native execution shape on misses but computes all images, so real-history benefit may be very small. Existing per-image LRU hit estimates do not apply; never replace the real sequence with fixed repeated warm inputs.

proposals_only.name: Canonical fixed vision execution shape
proposals_only.design: A separately redesigned encoder with fixed per-image arithmetic/tiling could make cache entries independent of current miss batch shape.
proposals_only.limits: Per-image forwards can add substantial launch overhead; padding every miss batch to full size can eliminate saved compute. Changing encoder arithmetic requires new accuracy/quality evidence and cannot be claimed as a drop-in bitwise optimization.
